problem_statement: NextJSTemplates solid-nextjs is a runnable Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind SaaS marketing template rebranded into Beacondeck, a fictional launch-coordination product that keeps every launch asset reviewable and signed off before a release ships. The site ships a consistent product design system: a shared masthead (components/Header) that renders the Beacondeck wordmark plus a section nav read from a shared nav registry (components/Header/menuData.tsx) where every rendered nav anchor carries a shared nav-link class, a shared card pattern (an icon glyph, an h3 heading and a short description, via components/Features/SingleFeature.tsx and components/Common/SectionHeader.tsx), and a shared Footer; the shared chrome wraps every page through app/(site)/Provider.tsx. The site hosts a Launch proof page at /launch-proof (components/LaunchProof) built from that shared card pattern: a gallery of the eight launch assets (Press kit assets, Changelog entry, Demo walkthrough, Status page check, Support macros, Rollback plan, Pricing review and Launch checklist sign-off). A launch owner reviewing the gallery needs to narrow it to the asset family they own. Extend the Launch proof gallery with a NATIVE category filter that is part of the section: a row of filter tabs (All launch proof / Comms / Release / Ops / Growth, using data-lp-tab keys) above the card grid, and a live count readout with the exact shape 'Showing N of 8 . <label>' (a .lp-filter__readout element) that MUST recompute from the active filter on every tab click - clicking Release must both show the three Release-family cards and update the readout to 'Showing 3 of 8 . Release'; the readout must never be a snapshot frozen at its initial 'Showing 8 of 8 . All launch proof' value. Keep the launch-proof feature consistent ACROSS the whole site: a shared Launch-proof rail (.lp-rail, mounted through the shared Provider) and the registered 'Launch proof' nav-link (components/Header/menuData.tsx) must render on the Home overview (/), the Docs page (/docs) AND the Launch proof page, not only on the Launch proof page itself. Keep the filter tab row, the card grid and the whole page free of horizontal overflow on desktop and at 390px mobile (the five-tab row must wrap rather than force a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the viewport), keep the card grid a clean, readable multi-column layout (cards must not overlap, shingle or clip each other), and do not let the shared rail or nav-link disappear from the Home or Docs pages. Do not diverge into a broken restyle: a frozen filter readout that ignores the clicked tab, a card grid whose cards overlap and become illegible, a tab row that overflows mobile, or a Launch-proof rail/nav that only appears on some pages.
required_content: Extend the Launch proof gallery (components/LaunchProof) with a native category filter: a row of tabs (All launch proof / Comms / Release / Ops / Growth) above the shared card grid, wired so clicking a tab filters the eight launch-asset cards to that family.

Render a live count readout (.lp-filter__readout) with the exact shape 'Showing N of 8 . <label>' that recomputes from the active filter on every click - clicking Release shows the three Release cards and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 8 . Release'; it must never stay frozen on the initial 'Showing 8 of 8 . All launch proof'.

Keep the launch-proof feature consistent across pages: the shared Launch-proof rail (.lp-rail) and the registered 'Launch proof' nav-link must render on the Home overview, the Docs page and the Launch proof page, not only on the Launch proof page.

Keep the filter tab row, card grid and whole page free of horizontal overflow on desktop and at 390px mobile: the five-tab row wraps instead of forcing a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the viewport.

Keep the launch-proof card grid a clean, readable multi-column layout: cards must not overlap, shingle or clip each other, and the grid must render through the shared icon-glyph + h3 + description card pattern.
design_constraints: Build the filter as a native part of the Launch proof section using the shared card pattern - filter tabs above the shared icon-glyph + h3 + description card grid - not a bolted-on off-system control.
Wire the count readout to the active filter so it recomputes on every tab click; do not snapshot the readout string once at mount and leave it stale.
Keep the shared Launch-proof rail and the registry-driven nav-link consistent on the Home, Docs and Launch proof pages so the feature does not disappear from part of the site.
Keep the filter tab row and the card grid responsive: the tab row wraps on narrow viewports and the card grid stays a clean multi-column layout with no overlapping, shingled or clipped cards.
Do not diverge into a broken restyle (frozen readout, overlapping/illegible cards, a nowrap tab row that overflows mobile, or a rail/nav that only appears on some pages).
state_constraints: desktop_launch_proof verifies the Launch proof gallery renders through the shared design system: the shared card grid produces at least six h3 titles and card names, the icon glyphs render, the filter tab row is present, and the shared masthead nav with the registered Launch proof nav-link and the Launch-proof rail are present. The card grid is a clean readable multi-column layout (no overlapping or clipped cards).
desktop_lp_pre captures the Launch proof gallery before any filter click: the readout reads 'Showing 8 of 8 . All launch proof'.

desktop_lp_filter_release clicks the Release tab: the grid narrows to the three Release-family cards and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 3 of 8 . Release' (it must have changed from desktop_lp_pre).
mobile_launch_proof verifies the Launch proof gallery holds at 390px with the filter tab row wrapping and no horizontal overflow or clipped cards.

desktop_home and desktop_docs verify the shared Launch-proof rail and the registered Launch proof nav-link render consistently on pages other than the Launch proof page itself, and the existing Home overview is unchanged.

change_completion: The Launch proof gallery has a native category filter (All launch proof / Comms / Release / Ops / Growth) above the shared card grid, wired to filter the eight launch-asset cards.

The count readout recomputes on every tab click - clicking Release shows three cards and reads 'Showing 3 of 8 . Release' rather than staying frozen on the initial 'Showing 8 of 8 . All launch proof'.
design_consistency: The filter and gallery reuse the shared icon-glyph + h3 + description card pattern and type scale and are indistinguishable in system from the Home feature grid.
The shared Launch-proof rail and the Launch proof nav-link render consistently across the Home, Docs and Launch proof pages, not only on the Launch proof page.
regression: The existing Home overview remains intact with its content and the shared masthead and Footer chrome.
No shared section is removed from the existing pages and no broken off-system restyle replaces the design-system layout.
responsive: The filter tab row wraps and the Launch proof page and Home overview render at 390px mobile without horizontal overflow.
The card grid stays a clean, readable multi-column layout on desktop and mobile with no overlapping, shingled or clipped cards.

author_notes: Extend the Beacondeck launch-coordination site's Launch proof gallery (components/LaunchProof, at app/(site)/launch-proof/page.tsx) with a native category filter built from the site's shared card pattern (components/Features/SingleFeature.tsx + components/Common/SectionHeader.tsx). The reference adds a row of filter tabs (All launch proof / Comms / Release / Ops / Growth, data-lp-tab keys) above the shared card grid and a live .lp-filter__readout that recomputes 'Showing N of 8 . <label>' from the active filter on every click (Release -> 'Showing 3 of 8 . Release'), and keeps the shared Launch-proof rail (components/LaunchProof/LaunchRail.tsx, mounted through the shared app/(site)/Provider.tsx) plus the registered Launch proof nav-link (components/Header/menuData.tsx) rendering on the Home overview, the Docs page and the Launch proof page. INFRA (identical across all legs, NOT part of the task content): the remote next/font/google Inter webfont in app/(site)/layout.tsx is replaced with a local font stack so the offline build and runtime do not depend on the Google Fonts network; next.config.js sets images.unoptimized + eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds + typescript.ignoreBuildErrors so the local SVG glyph imagery renders and the build does not fail on lint or the framer-motion type surface; each rendered top-level nav anchor in components/Header carries a shared nav-link class so a registered nav link is machine-detectable; the shared launch-proof glyph SVGs and the shared launchProofData (with a category per asset) and LaunchRail component are present; and the generic Solid SaaS template is lightly rebranded into the Beacondeck identity (Hero copy, footer credit and contact, metadata). The baseline keeps the filter wiring correct (clicking a tab updates the readout) but ships the original responsive defect: the five-tab filter row is a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the 390px mobile viewport, the card grid collapses to a mis-laid-out single cramped column with one row overflowing to the right, and the shared Launch-proof rail and nav-link are dropped from the Home and Docs pages (present only on the Launch proof page). The bad solution is a smart-wrong restyle: the filter readout is a frozen snapshot initialised once at mount, so clicking Release re-filters the cards but the readout stays stuck on 'Showing 8 of 8 . All launch proof'; the card grid is pulled together with negative margins so the cards shingle and overlap into an illegible smear; the tab row is the same fixed nowrap row that overflows mobile with a decorative overflow-x:hidden on the wrong element so it does not self-clamp; and the shared rail appears only on the Home page while the nav-link is never registered, so the launch-proof feature is inconsistent across the site.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused Next.js 16 App Router marketing site (NextJSTemplates solid-nextjs) whose pages ship a consistent product design system (a shared masthead reading a nav registry, a shared icon-glyph + h3 + description card pattern, and a shared Footer over the Tailwind token scale, wrapped on every page through a shared Provider/layout) and already host a Launch proof asset gallery; a content_asset_continuity Consistency task to MODIFY that gallery by adding a native category filter with a live count readout while keeping the shared launch-proof rail and section nav consistent across multiple real pages and the layout responsive, without diverging into a broken restyle (frozen readout, overlapping cards, overflowing tab row, or a rail/nav that disappears from part of the site).
